## OVERVIEW

Void Core Technologies builds AI-native software systems, autonomous agents, and scalable SaaS platforms for startups and enterprises.

We specialize in secure, production-grade architectures with strong developer experience (DX), automation-first workflows, and modular backend systems.

## PRIMARY PRODUCTS

ClauseMind  
AI-powered contract intelligence system that analyzes legal documents, identifies risks, simplifies clauses, and generates structured summaries.

VoidCore Scaffold  
Backend scaffolding engine (CLI + UI) that generates modular APIs with CRUD, authentication, and database integration.

EnvPilot  
Developer-first environment configuration manager for teams and scalable SaaS products.
